description: Na₃VO₂B₆O₁₁ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.65 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.98 Å. V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.87 Å. There are six inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.53 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.54 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.39 Å. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.47-1.53 Å. In the sixth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.37-1.39 Å. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one B atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one V, and one B atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms.
